operating_notes.text: Group booked a one-time ₹486.45 lakh employee-benefit provision under the New Labour Codes as an exceptional item in Q3FY26; standalone was ₹374.67 lakh.
Augmento Labs Private Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary, is proposed to merge into Saksoft with appointed date 1 April 2026, subject to approvals; no impact on these results.
Earlier merger of Threesixty Logica Testing Services, DreamOrbit Softech and Terafast Networks into Saksoft was completed with NCLT order dated 21 March 2025 and INC-28 filed 1 April 2025.
Pipeline stood at USD 25 million, up from USD 5 million six months earlier, with 95-98% from existing clients.
Top 20 customers contribute about 70% of revenue and 10 clients about 58%; outcome-based billing is about 10% of revenue.
Headcount was 2,494 at end-Q4FY26 with 2,277 technical and FY26 utilisation at 83% excluding trainees.
ESOP 2009 pool ceiling is 1,50,00,000 options, each convertible into one Re.1 equity share, administered by the Saksoft Employee Welfare Trust under the NRC.

timeline.summary: Meera Venkatramanan (VP-Company Secretary and Compliance Officer) uploaded earnings call recordings on May 26, 2026, to Saksoft’s investor website.
Saksoft's Q4FY26 earnings call (May 26, 2026) reported FY26 revenue crossing ₹1,000 Cr at ₹1,007 Cr, up 14%, with FY27 growth guided at 14-15%.

Saksoft on October 15, 2026 issued a postal ballot notice seeking special-resolution approval to amend ESOP 2009 and grant up to 66,27,562 options (5% of diluted capital) to Saksoft Inc. CEO Gurmeet Chahal, with voting from October 16 to November 14, 2026.
